title: Cat Factor: Redstone
description: A Data pack that changes some recipes of redstone componets with a realistic and cheap one.
body:
This Data pack rework some recipes of redstone components with a realistic and cheap one (most).

The point of the data pack is to make the recipes more accessible from the start of the game (by also removing nether exclusive items) and work with physhic to how the components works with the items and blocks required for craft them.

## How to Install
Insert the .zip file in your world's "datapacks" folder.

**(If you are installing the data pack from the Modrinth launcher, make sure to move the .zip file from the instance's "datapacks" folder to you world's "datapacks" folder.)**
